offerings.name: Search — Free Plan
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required.
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片搜索结果，含标题、描述和URL；可选返回全文Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results，按每10条向上取整；可免API key使用。

offerings.name: Search — Hobby
offerings.pricing: Hobby: $19/month billed monthly, or $16/month billed annually, for 5,000 credits per month (2,500 searches or 5,000 pages scraped).
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片搜索结果，含标题、描述和URL；可选抓取搜索结果全文
offerings.note: 超额$5/1,000 credits；搜索按结果数计费，2 credits/10 results并向上取整。
